decisions.reason: Because this air fin cooler is very close to the firm's core heat-exchange know-how, the firm has strong absorptive capacity to refine it and is unlikely to withdraw it after only one year.
This condenser fits the established portfolio and can be improved through the firm's in-house R&D, testing facilities and customer feedback, so keeping it is more likely than dropping it.

Although it is close to the firm's existing offer and therefore benefits from high related knowledge, the overlap with other condenser products creates some rationalization risk, but not enough to make withdrawal the base case.
The tube liner builds directly on the firm's installed-base service business and corrosion expertise, making it a commercially learnable extension that should stay on the market.
A customized industrial air cooler line strongly matches the firm's solution-oriented strategy, engineering capabilities and broad customer base, so it is very likely to be retained.
These repair inserts complement the firm's lifecycle services and draw on existing technical knowledge of heat exchanger maintenance, which lowers the chance of an early exit.
